canada.title: Cautious support in N.L. for abolition of the Indian Act
canada.summary: Some Indigenous people in Newfoundland and Labrador are cautiously supporting the Manitoba premier's call for the abolition of the Indian Act. They agree the legislation adopted in 1876 should be scrapped, but they want assurances that whatever replaces it will be better.

Americans head to the polls Tuesday to vote in U.S. midterm elections that will serve as a referendum on President Donald Trump’s chaotic and controversial second term, The Canadian Press reports.
Death toll hits 31 after Russian strike on Ukrainian aid site, with dozens still missing, The Canadian Press reports.
US military strikes Iran’s Qeshm Island day before midterms, The Hill reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
